description: Election Commission - Declare tha appointment of the Chairman, Vice Chairman and a member of the Kamburupitiya P/S
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government offices (Chairman, Vice Chairman, and Member) of the Kamburupitiya Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including nominations by political parties and declarations by the Returning Officer, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters and appointments.
